result_tail:
ot the cause
`shop.py:64` divides by `units_in_stock` with no guard. Product 3 has 0 stock, so `/products/3` always gives 500. **Only my own probes triggered this** — no user request reached it. I recorded it as latent, not as the incident. It will hit users when any product goes to 0 stock.

### What I could not answer
Who turned chaos mode on, and whether it was intended. The `/chaos` surface is outside my read-only contract. That is the one question that ends the user impact, and it needs an operator.
